<thought>Attempt to find a commercially available version of the aromatic fragment without the bromine (the aniline core bearing the protected piperazine). This fragment is the target after the C‑N coupling step, so if it is buyable we can avoid the Buchwald‑Hartwig step and instead perform a direct sulfonamide formation on a commercially available aniline that already contains the protected piperazine. I will search the catalog for the SMILES of this fragment.</thought>
